name: Occam's Razor (Principle of Parsimony)
axiom: Prefer the design that explains everything with the fewest added assumptions.
trigger: Options and edge-case branches pile up until nobody can describe the main path.

checklist.text: Delete gradients, dividers, and wrapper elements that carry no content and no state.
Render one primary action on a transactional screen and demote the rest below it.
Merge Filter, Sort, and Search into one query bar when they act on the same collection.
Time first-time users on the main task before and after a simplification, not just their opinion of it.

antiPattern.violation: An editor shows 45 toolbar buttons for rare typographic cases, so new writers cannot find bold or undo.
antiPattern.remediation: A bare canvas appears first, with a contextual toolbar only while text is selected.
